title: nucleus
description: A nucleus j on a Heyting algebra A is a closure operator (extensive, idempotent) that additionally preserves finite meets: j(a ∧ b) = j(a) ∧ j(b). The meet-preservation is what forces Fix(j) to inherit the full Heyting algebra structure (not merely the lattice structure) from A. Equivalently, a nucleus is a KZ-lax-idempotent monad on the poset A. Saturating and transferring at the articulating regime each act as a nucleus on the per-fiber Heyting algebra.
